changelog: **Alt text for announcement and newsletter images (EN 301 549 11.8.2 / Section 508 504.3, #3388):** `AnnouncementImage.altText` and `NewsletterImage.altText` (nullable `VarChar(500)`). Both admin composers show a "Describe this image" field when an image is attached (`imageAlt` multipart field; announcement and newsletter PATCH accept `imageAlt` to change it on an existing image, '' = decorative; over 500 → 400 `too_long`). The feed, the /announcements page, the admin history, the newsletter archive and both mails (announcement `cid:` image, newsletter hero) render it as `alt`, empty when none was given. Support-conversation images follow in #3407; VPAT 11.8.2, 504.2, 504.3 updated.

en: Images in announcements and newsletters can now be described, so screen-reader users hear what they show.
tr: Duyuru ve bültenlerdeki resimler artık tanımlanabiliyor; ekran okuyucu kullananlar resimde ne olduğunu duyuyor.
de: Bilder in Ankündigungen und Newslettern lassen sich jetzt beschreiben – Screenreader lesen vor, was sie zeigen.
